content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Sells billing and telecom software and operations to communications and media operators, not government consulting or defense services."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Makes network security hardware and sells subscriptions through channel partners, rather than contract consulting and services to government."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Sells research subscriptions and conferences to executives and vendors, not government technology consulting or engineering contracts."},{"label":"C4","good":true,"reason":"Provides engineering, consulting and cyber services under government contracts for defense and federal clients, similar to the target's model."},{"label":"C5","good":true,"reason":"Delivers engineering, systems integration and cybersecurity services to US defense and intelligence agencies via government contracts, closely matching the target."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Sells software licenses and subscriptions for application and data platforms to enterprises, with no government services model."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Places contract engineering, healthcare and IT staff with corporate clients on hourly bill rates, lacking government and defense focus."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Sells telecom hardware appliances and communications software to carriers and enterprises, a different product and customer base."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Sells cloud work-management software by subscription to enterprises and agencies, without the target's consulting or engineering services model."}]}
